# SpecGov

SpecGov is the Git-native governance layer for artifacts created and consumed during AI-assisted software development.

- Canonical: https://paladini.io/specgov/
- Repository: https://github.com/paladini/specgov
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/specgov
- Core: deterministic local graph and policy analysis
- Frameworks: GitHub Spec Kit, OpenSpec, Kiro, Generic/TLC
- CLI: specgov init, specgov check, specgov graph
- Boundaries: no inferred AI authorship, verified provenance, mandatory LLM, hosted service, or default network calls
